text:
sumi: quick heads-up from onboarding: node sampleapp (fresh quickstart) sometimes logs duplicate X-Req-Id when the retry middleware kicks in and OTEL is set to auto. also saw raw emails in INFO logs for one of our test routes.

alex_dev: ugh. can you share the middleware stack? sounds like ordering + auto-init race.

sumi: stack (approx): bodyParser -> otel.autoInit() -> reqLogger.snapshot() -> auth -> redactHook -> retryMiddleware -> routes. repro: curl /chat 3x quickly, two requests show same reqid `r-zz12` and both logs include user.email in the snapshot.

taylor: two separate but related bugs: (1) logger.snapshot() runs before redactHook so bodies/headers with PII get captured, (2) otel.autoInit() creates a global tracer and on fast retries the retry wrapper can re-enter the same active context so reqid binding is shared.

alex_dev: that aligns with a scaffolding change we shipped last month. python quickstart had reqid->redact->logger order, node drifted. fix plan: make reqid the first middleware, move redactHook right after bodyParser, and delay OTEL auto-init to be per-request or add an attribute filter.

sumi: quick mitigation I tried: moved reqid to the top and redaction before logger.snapshot locally, that removed the email leak. still saw a single duplicate reqid once when retry retried within ~30ms.

build-bot: CI run for branch `sumi/telemetry-fix-3612` queued  build 890 expected in ~4m.

alex_dev: for duplicate reqid case add a tiny guard in reqid middleware: if generated id equals current active id in context and time delta < 100ms, regenerate (cheap debounce). longer-term we should ensure tracer context is request-scoped when OTEL is enabled at runtime.

taylor: also propose adding an OTEL attribute processor that blocks or hashes known PII keys (email, phone, ssn) by default in quickstarts. users can opt-in to include more attributes. keeps defaults safe.

sumi: i'll open a PR with (a) reqid-first, (b) redact-before-snapshot, (c) small reqid debounce guard, (d) test that asserts no email-like strings in logs/spans for a synthetic request. linking issue when done.

ops: please also update the onboarding faststart doc: call out REDWOOD_OTEL=auto caveat and recommend REDWOOD_OTEL=0 for new users until scaffolding parity is fixed.

alex_dev: agreed. i'll sync the quickstart templates so node matches python and add the telemetry privacy CI check.

sumi: filed issue RDW-5621 with logs and repro steps: https://redwood-internal/issue/5621 :eyes:

build-bot: staging deploy for `sumi/telemetry-fix-3612` scheduled after CI green. :rocket:

alex_dev: thanks sumi — this explains a few recent support tickets. small scaffold fixes but high impact. :thumbsup:
